faqs.q: Where is AMASS available across Africa?
faqs.a: AMASS is live in 20+ cities with the deepest inventory in Lagos, Abuja, Accra and Nairobi — and expanding rapidly across the continent.
Every listing passes document checks, ownership validation and agent identity verification before it earns a verified badge.
All payments can move through AMASS Escrow, so funds are only released when both parties meet agreed conditions.
It's our AI + satellite layer delivering valuations, neighbourhood scores, risk analysis and market predictions on any property.

faqs.q: How do I become an AMASS agent?
faqs.a: Tap ‘Become an Agent’, complete verification, and start listing with a full CRM, analytics and marketing suite.
